title: Can You Refreeze Thawed Chicken?

seo.title: Can You Refreeze Thawed Chicken?
seo.meta_description: Chicken thawed in the refrigerator can be refrozen if it stayed at 40°F (4°C) or below and within its safe storage time, although quality may decline.
seo.search_intent: Resolve the question “Can You Refreeze Thawed Chicken?” using food-safety, condition, compatibility, and time limits instead of a one-size-fits-all rule.

excerpt: Chicken thawed in the refrigerator can be refrozen if it stayed at 40°F (4°C) or below and within its safe storage time, although quality may decline. Chicken thawed at room temperature or held warm too long does not become safe again by refreezing.
content_html:
Chicken thawed in the refrigerator can be refrozen if it stayed at 40°F (4°C) or below and within its safe storage time, although quality may decline. Chicken thawed at room temperature or held warm too long does not become safe again by refreezing.

Refrigerator-thawed chicken can be refrozen

If chicken thawed entirely in the refrigerator and stayed cold, it can go back into the freezer without cooking. Expect some loss of moisture and texture from another freeze-thaw cycle.

Chicken thawed in cold water or the microwave should be cooked first

These methods can warm portions of the food into temperatures where bacteria grow. Cook the chicken immediately, then freeze the cooked chicken if longer storage is needed.

Time out of refrigeration is not reset by freezing

If it sat at room temperature for more than two hours, or more than one hour above about 90°F (32°C), discard it. Smell and color cannot guarantee safety.

Label the new freeze date to keep track

Mark the refreeze date and use that package first. Freezing stops microbial growth but does not kill every microorganism or undo unsafe handling before freezing.

faq.question: Can I refreeze chicken thawed in the refrigerator?
faq.answer: If chicken thawed entirely in the refrigerator and stayed cold, it can go back into the freezer without cooking. Expect some loss of moisture and texture from another freeze-thaw cycle.

faq.question: What changes if chicken was thawed in the microwave or cold water?
faq.answer: These methods can warm portions of the food into temperatures where bacteria grow. Cook the chicken immediately, then freeze the cooked chicken if longer storage is needed.

faq.question: Can chicken left on the counter for hours be refrozen safely?
faq.answer: If it sat at room temperature for more than two hours, or more than one hour above about 90°F (32°C), discard it. Smell and color cannot guarantee safety.
